text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Haa...!
Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Why...
No, losing like this... it's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Both countermeasures and training!
Stack them up, over and over and over again!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Even though I've grown more than anyone...! ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...Are you saying... I haven't gotten stronger at all...?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder if Ms. Gentil... feels the same way too――"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—...Yes.
I suppose that was the reason for my defeat.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"……Defeat.
I have received this humiliation loud and clear."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I was not able to exert my full strength this time. However... next time will be different.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Let us proceed with preparations for the Shuka Sho.
—We shall hone your strength even further."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
W-Why...
Why aren't you wavering...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, that was so close~...
But you were really strong, weren't you!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean...
Doesn't Gentildonna-san look way too relaxed!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Her breathing has already settled back to normal.
Her baseline physical ability really must be incredible..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I had a rival like that...
...it'd send chills down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...It's no good, not like this...
I have to get stronger, much stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Still, how?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race,
while waiting with her younger sisters for Verxina, who was taking a long time to return—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I'm fine.
More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You showed such an unsightly display, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's not true!
Big Sis, you were amazing too!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —...Even I feel that way, you know.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: She was the one who was truly amazing... Far more than I ever was...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I need to...
grow so much, much more.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate,
I... cannot win the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: If I disgrace myself any further, I won't have the right to speak of reaching the pinnacle...!
choice_data_list: ...I heard your feelings loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Desiring dramatic growth greater than ever before...
For Verxina, an opportunity second to none was right before her eyes.
choice_data_list: Let's push ourselves to the limit at summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp held to sharpen the Umamusume's
abilities... There, they show tremendous growth.
However, that meant—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...Which means Ms. Gentil will become even stronger than she is now..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
B-But... you never know, right?
Maybe big sis can get a whole lot stronger!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Vivlos.
If not... there is no future.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: In the next Shuka Sho, I want to be stronger than anyone else. Please—train me to my absolute limits!
